dialog.content: Hi there. You wouldn't happen to know where we are?
I am Shion Fumihiro. I'm an ul-
Wait I don't know this person, what if he's the one who kidnapped me here.
Sorry, I started stuttering. Bad habit of mine.
It's fine really. I don't blame you for being scared in a situation like this.
Well, I am scared. But I'm not in the mood for your sympathy.
Could I perhaps know your name?
I am Noriyuki Wato, the ultimate guitarist.
By the way you weren't completely honest with me. It's obvious you are an ultimate too.
Yeah, true... I am an ultimate spy. Wasn't sure if I should've hidden it.
But what do you know about this place, anything?
I honestly have no clue, I just well... woke up from whatever I was doing last night.
If I had to guess, based on how we all remember nothing. It's done on purpose.
